notes: English documents; INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR (hourly) - check Blue Card compatibility / ask for EOR employment before signing; company undisclosed; 3h US Central overlap; posted 5h, 12 applicants: apply fast
verdict: The core of the role fits well: I have built LLM evaluation against ground truth twice (Kniit, Covestro thesis), and the "deterministic checks before LLM-as-a-judge" philosophy is exactly what I did at Kniit ($200k → near zero). The gaps are around the edges: GitHub Actions specifically, tracing tools, adversarial/prompt-injection testing, multi-run statistics and load testing. The biggest risk isn't skills. It's the independent-contractor arrangement versus my EU Blue Card (see red flags).
gaps: Adversarial / prompt-injection testing, load testing, multi-run CIs
